resources.string: Root read failed. Basic values are shown; protected readings are unavailable.
Battery-side voltage × current. This is not measured USB input power. Positive means charging; negative means discharging.
Visible app only. Sampling stops in the background; idle battery sampling uses at least 10 seconds. No wake lock or background service.

Only enabled votes are listed. “Selected” identifies the driver’s reported winning vote. Current/voltage limits are settings, not measurements. No active entries is not proof that every hardware limit is clear.
These are live device-tree settings, not detection of the currently selected power profile. LRP is not the same as battery temperature. Crossing a threshold alone does not prove a limit is active.
Connect with root to read this device’s charging settings. Captured values from another device are never substituted.
Values come from this device. Presence of a setting does not mean its branch is active. Empty flags and numeric zero are different. Units and unresolved conditions are documented per item.
Charging settings are unavailable on this device.
Up to 360 samples held in memory for this app session. Gaps are not filled. Export explicitly to keep the data.
Samples will appear here while monitoring.

Reads Android battery values, selected battery sysfs attributes, driver vote status and the live battery device-tree node. No charging settings, thermal protections, services, system properties or device configuration are changed. Root is used only for the fixed read commands. No Xposed module is required.

Some firmware hides or changes fields. Missing values remain unavailable. The app does not derive charger wattage from battery current or choose a 45 W / 60 W profile from observed watts. Built-in descriptions are not a substitute for the live device settings.
Grant root access to read LRP, control votes and charging settings. Without root, only Android battery readings are available.
Start / recovery values. Array indices do not identify an active branch; the mapping may be unresolved.
BZI9 reference: the reviewed battery thermal-zone code shifts boundaries by 1.9°C according to the previous zone. This is not a measurement of the currently applied boundary.
Root is needed to identify controls
Current limited by late charging step %1$d
Step charging is adjusting the limit
The main cause is not determined
No active charging cause is inferred from earlier readings. This includes disconnected or paused charging.
Charging may have ended or be topping off. Full status alone does not identify a temperature limit.
Android battery values do not identify the driver controls. Connect with root for more evidence.
A temperature-related request is selected by the driver. Other limits can apply at the same time.
The driver selected battery protection. This report alone does not distinguish every temperature or voltage condition behind it.
The selected control concerns charging policy, the charge limit, USB or input-current adjustment. Check the evidence below.
The direct charger reports constant-voltage mode. Current can taper while voltage is held; this is an observed mode, not proof of a temperature limit.
Step charging adjusts current or voltage as charging progresses. Its settings are separate from temperature controls.
A lower measured wattage or a temperature reading alone cannot identify the cause. No guessed cause is shown.
Step %1$d setting and the selected battery current limit both equal %2$s. The maximum step setting is %3$s.
Step %1$d setting: %2$s (table maximum %3$s). It does not match the selected current limit, so this is context only.
The driver labels the current selection as a cable setting. Attribution to the step is inferred from the matching live table and state.
Temperature controls: no enabled request reported
Temperature controls: a request is enabled, but another selection is reported
This identifies reported controls, not every hardware limit or the active 45 W / 60 W profile.
